intent: One bot runtime every Telegram byte flows through, testable without the network.
change: packages/bot grammY runtime: long-poll dev + webhook-ready prod behind one config switch, transcript persistence middleware (all in/out/refused messages), per-chat token-bucket rate limiting, test-transport harness for CI.
done_when: Integration tests prove transport config boots both modes, transcript rows land for in/out/refused, and the rate limiter refuses floods with one notice per window.

intent: The authorization root: one chat, one user, bound by a one-time code.
change: Binding-code issue endpoint, /start consumption with transactional consume+bind, expiry, single-use, rebind refusal, unbound-chat single how-to-bind reply.
done_when: Integration tests prove the accepted binding path, expired/unknown/consumed/rebind refusals with nothing bound, consume+bind atomicity under fault injection, and the single how-to-bind reply.

intent: Natural language in, exactly one structured CRUD effect out, on a hard budget.
change: Anthropic tool runner loop with Zod tools wrapping CRUD (watch create/list/pause, calendar create/list, task create and status read - a cancellation order lands a queued task row, execution stays s5's), per-message tool-call budget, no-tool-fits honesty, ambiguous-order clarification, CRUD-refusal passthrough, LLM-outage reply, scripted-transcript test harness.
done_when: Scripted-LLM integration tests prove accepted create/list/pause with API-visible effects, a cancellation order landing a queued task row with a queued-confirming reply, ambiguous-order clarification, budget exhaustion, no-tool-fits refusal, CRUD 4xx passthrough, and outage behavior; a tagged @live-llm test maps a phrasing variant to the correct tool call.

intent: The single outbound door later sprints deliver notifications through.
change: Typed sendToUser(userId, message) resolving the binding, sending via the runtime, writing a delivery record; failed sends record failed delivery with retry per policy.
done_when: Integration tests prove sendToUser reaches the test transport with a delivery record, unbound users yield a typed no-binding error, and send failure records failed delivery observably.

intent: When the agent has asked a question, the user's next message is the answer, not a new command.
change: Router checking for a pending task question for the bound user: answer routes to the question's answer sink (stub question record in this sprint), otherwise to the chat loop; never swallows a message.
done_when: Integration tests prove an answer reaches the stubbed sink and normal chat reaches the loop, with exactly-one-destination asserted, and transcript rows for both.

intent: The whole front door, end to end: bind, ask, effect, reply.
change: Composed integration suite: fresh chat binds, natural-language watch creation lands a CRUD row and confirming reply, list/pause round-trips, each refused state replies distinctly, transcripts complete for every exchange.
done_when: The composed suite is green against Testcontainers with test transport and scripted LLM, covering accepted paths, all refused states, and transcript completeness; optional manual live-bot sanity check documented but not gating.
